description: Sign an Ethereum transaction (legacy or EIP-1559) with the named portal. Returns `signed` (the signed transaction as 0x-prefixed hex, ready for eth_sendRawTransaction) and `preview`: what sigil decoded the call to and, when a simulation RPC is configured, what the dry-run did (balance changes, approvals, revert reason, warnings). Show the user the preview, and treat any warning in it as a reason to stop and check. A policy may deny a tx whose simulation reverts or that cannot be simulated; the error says why.

tx.description: Transaction fields. type="legacy" requires {chainId, nonce, gasPrice, gasLimit, to, value, data}. type="eip1559" requires {chainId, nonce, maxPriorityFeePerGas, maxFeePerGas, gasLimit, to, value, data, accessList?}. To deploy a contract, set to=null (explicit JSON null, not omitted) and put the creation bytecode in data. Numbers may be supplied as JSON numbers or decimal strings.

name: sigil_eth_sign_transaction
